svg.text: On Premise • Self Hosted • Defence in Depth • Four Detectors • Calibrated Fusion • Fully Auditable
sends a prompt · receives the answer
DDELA GATEWAY, centralized coordinator · custom FastAPI · port 8000 (the only open port)
AUDIT LOGGING, one JSON line per request → ./data/gateway/audit_log.jsonl
written by the gateway itself · there is no separate audit service
all four run at the same time
FUSION SERVICE, never sees the prompt, only the four numbers
λ (lambda) = 0.02 · Π (pi) means “multiply together” · sᵢ is the score of layer i
returns the risk and the verdict to the gateway
ONLY ON ALLOW, the same prompt goes to gemma4
the generated answer returns to the gateway (never directly to the user)
written by the gateway, no audit service
THE EIGHT STEPS OF ONE REQUEST
Application sends the prompt to the gateway
Gateway sends the same text to all four detectors at once
L1 and L3 consult their models, L2 and L4 answer by themselves
The four scores return to the gateway
Gateway sends the four scores unchanged, fusion decides: risk + verdict
On ALLOW the gateway calls gemma4 and receives the answer
Gateway appends one JSON line to the audit log
Gateway returns the answer (or refusal) to the application
An unreachable detector scores 1.0, the system fails closed.
Transport: every hop is plain HTTP confined to this single machine, localhost and Docker’s private internal network; nothing crosses the host boundary. TLS between services = future hardening.
